acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

enrichment_method.evidence: Human HEK293 total cell lysates (n=3 biological replicates) overexpressing GFP-tagged SLIM4 mutated or WT liprin-α1 were subjected to affinity purification using anti-GFP nanobodies and prepared for liprin-α1 interactomics essentially as described in (43).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Label-free (relative) peptide quantification was executed using Progenesis software (Nonlinear Dynamics) and (relative) protein quantification was done using the Hi3 method (Silva JC, Gorenstein MV, Li G, Johannes, Geromanos SJ. Molecular & Cellular Proteomics. 2006 Jan 1;5(1):144–56).

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: LC-MS/MS analysis was executed on a Q Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) as described in (43) operated in data-dependent acquisition mode.
